_comment: PROPOSAL ONLY. Review, then copy to .claude/settings.json (project) or .claude/settings.local.json before the unattended run, which starts in the main checkout on develop (D31). Compaction (D31): the agent definitions set autoCompactWindow (absolute tokens; all models default to a 1M window): 600000 for the Sonnet/Haiku agents (~60%) and 800000 for imsrg-lead (~80%); the top-level autoCompactWindow below gives the orchestrator (main session) ~80%, and agents with their own frontmatter value do not inherit it. Do not set CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE (it also applies to subagents, on top of their windows) or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW (it overrides all of these). The deny list blocks pushing, remote changes, the shared git stash, and history- or file-destroying commands (git clean would delete the untracked imsrg-devel/ and test inputs in the main checkout root). Allow rules are a convenience, not a security boundary. For a hard guarantee against pushing, the owner can also run: git -C /Users/cheshyre/Downloads/new-imsrg remote set-url --push origin DISABLED
